about: Town and wild critter sheets (epic #830), cut by scripts/art/lpc-critters.mjs from LPC-compatible animal sets, as render/critters.js draws them: sprite:critter-<kind>-<variant>, the variant being the index of that kind's palette in critters.js, and birds also sprite:critter-<kind>-<variant>-fly. `sets` is where a set comes from and the licence it is used under: only CC-BY-SA 3.0, OGA-BY 3.0 or CC0. A kind: `set`, `src` the image in assets/packs/<set>/, `cell` [w, h] a frame, `dirs` the source row per sheet row (down, left, right, up), `fly` the same for a bird's flying frames, `cols` the source columns of stand, step, other step, `flip` the sheet rows mirrored from their source row, `xs`/`ys` where the frames of an uneven sheet start, `key` a background colour to clear, `outline` one art pixel round the figure, `ground` true when each frame must stand on the bottom row by itself (the rabbit's hop moves inside its cells), `side` true when the set has no front or back view (the renderer then keeps to left and right). A variant: `dc` a column offset (the colour blocks of a sheet), `tone` a colour multiplied over the grey pixels (white fur into brown), `map` exact colour swaps. Nothing is scaled: frames are cut at the set's own pixels. Not every kind is what it says: the goat is the LPC ram, and the chicken and deer are CC0 art that is LPC-compatible rather than LPC, because the LPC chicken, goat and deer are offered under CC-BY or GPL only.
